text: INT. DINGY MOTEL - NIGHT1 1

A motel room so rundown and dirty the cockroaches don't stay. SHANNON CLARK (29) lies sick in bed, coughing. She weakly reaches for a glass of water sitting on a warped nightstand carved up with graffiti. Shannon strains to reach the water. Too weak. KAREN MURPHY (28), uptown glam and loathe to be in a place so dirty, pushes open the door and steps inside. Her fiance, RICKY TRAX (29), sporting a tailored suit that oozes "powerful businessman...wannabe" follows Karen like a nervous puppy. Karen reaches for the glass of water and "accidentally" knocks it over. Shannon collapses in exhaustion. KARENWhoops. Karen covers her mouth and giggles like a bitch. She links arms with Ricky, showing off her engagement ring, of which the dazzling shine pierces through Shannon's heart. KAREN(cont'd)Tomorrow, we are getting married. As my ex-best friend, I believe you want to give us your blessing, right? SHANNONBlessing? Fine. (coughs) Can I have some of my money back? My treatment isn't covered by... KARENShannon, how did you end up so shameless? Did you plan to feed off of Ricky your whole life? Ricky nervously adjusts his suit over and over. He doesn't like being here, but he's not about to say no to Karen. SHANNONRicky, before I trusted you with my fortune, you were the son of my father's chauffeur...who's feeding off who? Ricky scowls and shoves Karen out of the way. He reaches over and grabs Shannon by the throat, half-lifting her out of the bed. His grip tightens and tightens...

RICKYYou think I'm feeding off of YOU? Your father has been dead for years. Before you had me, you were a loser about to drop out of college. I earned my worth with blood and sweat tutoring dumb rich kids like you. You're nothing but the daughter of a filthy rich dead guy! ...until he flings her back to the bed. SHANNONYou said you would marry me, not her, if I gave you control of the business. I'm asking you for less than one-percent of what I gave you. Karen stifles laughter. Ricky rolls his eyes. Shannon collapses in a fit of tears and coughing.
INT. DINGY MOTEL - NIGHT2 2

Ricky leans to get into Shannon's face, to be intimidating, but when he sees how sick she is, he recoils in disgust. RICKYHow dare you even to bring that up? I saved the Clark family business from YOU, the useless, spoiled brat, who'd been carrying HIV, and never bothered to tell ME UNTIL THE NIGHT BEFORE OUR WEDDING!
RICKYHow many people did you sleep with? How many excuses do you still have? With a broken heart, Shannon is no longer listening. SHANNONRicky, did you ever love me?

A beat. Ricky is stunned by the audacity of her question. Ricky and Karen burst out laughing. Shannon is devastated. RICKYLove? What an insult. Being stuck with a woman so stupid, disgusting and phony, looking back, everyday was like a nightmare. How can I love someone who only makes me sick?

Shannon grips her chest, coughing. Wet, nasty coughs. Disgusted, Ricky walks out, leaving Karen to deliver the final blow. KARENAw, look at you, here at the end and the only thing you want to know is if Ricky loved you. You should be asking how a drug-free virgin like you ended up with AIDS. SHANNONYou know...? KARENSince you're about to die. I'll have some mercy and tell you a little secret. Someone was hired to inject you with HIV. I'm surprised you never figured that out, or jumped off a building, to save the world from your disgrace. SHANNONWho would do that...why? KARENRicky. The love of your life didn't want to marry you. Twenty dollars to a junkie, he's free and you're the dirty slut. Nice and easy. Horrified, Shannon pushes herself off the bed as Karen leaves, trying to stop her. SHANNONNo, that can't be true. No... Shannon gurgles and chokes, coughs spraying blood.
EXT. DINGY MOTEL - NIGHT3 3

Karen and Ricky walk out of the hotel. They slow down when they see JOHNNY WONDER (30), a handsome, kind looking man hurrying towards the motel. All three eye each other when they pass shoulders. There is history there.
INT. DINGY MOTEL - NIGHT4 4
Johnny kicks open the door and finds Shannon fallen halfway out of bed, unable to get up. JOHNNYShannon! He rushes to help as she coughs up more blood.
INT. DINGY MOTEL - NIGHT5 5

Johnny rushes to Shannon's side and pulls her close. She coughs blood all over his suit. JOHNNYYou need a doctor. Let me call 911... SHANNONJohnny Wonder...is it really you? She looks longingly into his eyes, stops him from calling. SHANNON(cont'd)It's too late. JOHNNYI'm so sorry, Shannon. I always thought you were doing well...happily married. If I had any idea it was like this...I would have stopped the wedding! I'd have taken you from Ricky Trax! Let me call an ambulance, please? Shannon smiles, almost laughing out of joy. Johnny is confused. Why is she laughing while dying? SHANNONI've never imagined, other than my father, there can be another man who cares so much about me. What a shame I wasted this life on a heartless monster. I'm a fool. Shannon, coughing more blood, has her eyes rolling back. She can barely keep her head upright. SHANNON(cont'd)In my next life, I will...choose differently... Shannon is breathing her last breath hearing: JOHNNYIn my next life, I will make you the happiest woman in the world. Tears falling down Johnny's face -- the last thing Shannon sees before she dies in his arms. Then, in an instant we are transported to...
INT. COLLEGE CLASSROOM - DAY6 6

A college classroom. Bright golden summer sunlight pours through a wall of windows. Desks are gleaming and every STUDENT in the room (including Shannon) wears casual clothes that cost thousands of dollars. Shannon is sleeping on her desk. JOHNNY (V.O.)(grieving as she dies)Shannon...Shannon...SHANNON! Shannon's eyes jolt open. She slowly lifts her head, unsure of where she is. Unsure why she's alive. Then she sees the name of her UNIVERSITY on a banner in the classroom. SHANNON (V.O.)This is...college? How can this be? I've been reborn ten years ago? Shannon (18) looks around and sees Ricky (19) and Karen (18) sitting next to each other one table away. Clearly a couple. RICKYWhat’s wrong, honey? KARENThe egg-salad gave me a tummy ache. Ricky looks at the lunch in front of Karen, then looks at Shannon who's still looking around the room in wonder. RICKY(to Karen)I'll be right back. Ricky walks over to Shannon. Shannon feels food coming from above: Ricky has dumped Karen's lunchbox on top of Shannon's head. Shannon is stunned. Frozen. Giggles everywhere. RICKY(cont'd)I told you to get some FOOD for Karen, not the garbage people like you eat. Go buy something edible. Shannon stares at Ricky, her face a cool, collected mask of rage. It unnerves Ricky to his core.
INT. CLASSROOM - DAY7 7
Shannon wipes egg-salad from her face.

SHANNON (V.O.)Ricky Trax, in my previous life, I gave you everything, only for you to betray and murder me. This time will be different. RICKYAre you deaf? Go! Now! KARENRicky. Maybe I'd better go myself. Karen gives a pouty, simpering vibe that is pure condescension. Ricky raises his palm to stop Karen. RICKYWhy bother? Running errands for you makes her feel valued, right Shannon? SHANNON (V.O.)Yes. Let this meal start my revenge. Shannon stands up and walks out so purposefully Ricky smugly thinks his world is in order.

RICKY(whispering)Shannon what the hell are you doing? SHANNONYou still expect a free ride in my car after insulting me like that? Yancey and Sue watch from a distance, unable to hear what's being said, but willing to speculate anyway. YANCEYThat's Ricky's family car. Why does he let this bitch do that to him? SUEThat's what you get letting a maid's daughter ride with you. If you give a mouse a cookie... YANCEYC'mon Trax, just pull her out. RICKYDo you have to act like this? I forgive you about the lunch, but if you don't stop acting like this--
SHANNONI don't need your forgiveness. You can walk home. Stop following me. RICKY (V.O.)I have to get in the car. Or I'll be exposed. If anyone knows I'm the son of their driver...

Ricky grabs Shannon's wrist and yanks her out of the car. Flinging her to the ground. He tosses her purse after her. The students laugh and cheer. Ricky helps Karen in the back seat then he gets in front the other side. Nobody moves to help Shannon. SHANNONRicky Trax, how dare you push me? RICKYDrive. The car zooms away. Shannon climbs to her feet, brushes off her purse and grabs her phone. YANCEYWell done Ricky, dealing with some ungrateful low life. That's what she deserved. SUERicky is so cool. Shannon is on the phone. SHANNONDad, our driver has forgotten who he works for. YANCEYCalling Ricky, begging for forgiveness? It's too late. SHANNONThe one who will beg for forgiveness is him. Watch. My car is coming back. Yancey laughs in disbelief. But her smile fades when the car engine roars as it reverses back to Shannon. Ricky, and Karen climb out. Mr. Trax is most chastised of all. Everyone who mocked Shannon are stunned. MR. TRAXShannon, please get in the car. I'll take you wherever you want to go. Shannon walks past Yancey and Sue proudly in vindication and gets into the backseat.
INT. DINING HALL - DAY8 8

The dining hall is impressive, like if The Cheesecake Factory wasn't tacky. While Shannon picking up food, Yancey (18), a classmate struts up beside her ready to cause trouble. YANCEYFetching lunch for your master again? With brilliant girls like Karen around, Ricky won't waste a glance on your kind. You know that right? Other STUDENTS watch the show, giggling behind their hands. SHANNONWhat kind am I? YANCEYThe "daughter of his maid" kind. The "follows him to school every day" kind. The "dream of marrying rich" kind. The "if your lucky you can make his bed, sweep his floors, scrub his toilet" kind. You know. Your kind. SHANNONThat's what Ricky told you? Did he tell you "his luxury car" belongs to MY family? That he's the son of MY driver?

The crowd watching gets bigger, laughs a little louder. It doesn't phase Shannon at all. YANCEYWhat a psycho! Barking like a chihuahua just because Ricky won't look at you? Hurry up, your master's lunch is getting cold. SHANNON (V.O.)The driver's son saying I'm HIS maid! Ricky Trax, you are going to pay for that. Shannon takes her food and walks through the crowd that was watching and laughing. They all turn away in embarrassment.
INT. CLASSROOM - DAY9 9

Shannon sits at her desk, finishing up the food she was supposed to bring to Ricky and Karen. Karen, Ricky and Yancey walk in, seeing the empty containers in front of Shannon. RICKYI told you to bring food for Karen and you ate it? Mine too? God, you're such a pig. Shannon tosses her fork and knife down, and crosses her arms. She's done with this dude. SHANNONI bought this with my money. Two meals or twenty meals what does it have to do with you? YANCEYYour money? Even if you spend it, it's still Trax money. Duh. SHANNONWhat do you think, Ricky Trax? Who's money is it? RICKYI think getting lunch when you're told to get lunch for your boss is a simple task. He leans over and whispers loudly in her ear.

RICKY(cont'd)If someone can't get that right, she's gotta be stupid. SHANNONWho's my boss? Her? If this capable young woman is too lazy to get her own lunch, she deserves a tummy ache. RICKYYou— YANCEYYou're a Trax family maid. Taking care of his girlfriend is your job. Why is that so hard to comprehend? Ignoring Yancey, Shannon rises to her feet and faces Ricky. SHANNONRicky Trax. Am I your maid? Ricky flinches. He's not used to direct confrontation like this. RICKYAlright, Shannon, alright. I'm not interested in this little game you're playing. Don't cause trouble because I won't forgive you. No matter how much you beg me. SHANNONBeg you? Why would I? What have I done wrong? A stand-off. Ricky scoffs and rolls his eyes. RICKYYou think you're tough? Fine, there's no seat for you in my car. You can walk home. Everyone walks out, and Shannon watches them go. SHANNON (V.O.)Your car? It was never yours and it's time you learned your place.

Shannon smiles with amusement. SHANNON (V.O.)Oh there is a line to cross? I had no idea. But, this is just the beginning. Ricky Trax, Karen.... She slams the door, almost crushing Ricky's hand, leaving him and Karen embarrassed. The window glides down -- SHANNONBye. (to Mr. Trax.) Driver, drive. The car peels out.
EXT. SCHOOL PARKING LOT - DAY10 10
Shannon, with her handbag, walks toward a luxury car in front of everyone. She gets in the backseat, leaving them in awe. Yancey and her friends loudly gossip. The window is down.

YANCEYAfter insulting Ricky and Karen she still has the nerve to keep freeloading rides? Unbelievable! Yancey and her minions scoff. SUE (18), a student who socially clings to Yancey the way Yancey socially clings to Karen, chimes in. SUEA maid's daughter acting like a princess. YANCEYRicky is too kind. If it was me, I’d have already kicked her out.
INT. CAR - DAY11 11

Hearing their words, Shannon rolls up the window. Trying to relaxes, she closes her eyes. SHANNONDrive. The driver, MR. TRAX (50) Ricky's father turns around to address Shannon. He's in a suit, but a cheap one. MR. TRAXLet’s wait for Ricky. SHANNONMr. Trax, you work for my father and me. I decide who we wait for. MR. TRAXDid you have a fight with him or something? I'll have a word with Ricky, for sure. But try to be nicer to him, if you please. I know you look down on us, but... SHANNONDrive! I don’t want him in my car. I don't want him in my house. I don’t want to see him anymore! MR. TRAXWell, let’s wait. SHANNONAre you going to drive or not? MR. TRAX (V.O.)She's usually so scared of Ricky. What's going on today?

Did she forget I'm her future father in law, or the fact my son will take over her father's business? SHANNONMr. Trax I asked-- MR. TRAXLook, they’re coming out. Shannon, fuming, sees Ricky and Karen walking out of the building toward the car. Mr. Trax hops out, deferential as hell, opening the door to the backseat for his son. But when Ricky opens the door, Shannon grabs it and refuses to let Ricky inside. Panic flashes across Ricky's face.
EXT. SCHOOL - DAY13 13

Sue and Yancey watch the drama between Shannon, Ricky, and Mr. Trax play out in the parking lot. SUEEven Ricky's driver gets so respectful to a maid's daughter. This doesn't make sense. YANCEYWhy did Ricky get out? Mr. Trax clings to Shannon's door like it's a shield and timidly speaks over the top edge. MR. TRAXShannon, was it really necessary to bother your father? For your little argument with Ricky? He's very busy. SHANNONFrom now on, they two are not allowed in this car. MR. TRAXIsn't that a little--childish, Shannon? SHANNONYou are not close enough to use my name. Remember who pays you. I think to drive when your boss tells you to drive is a simple task. If you can't get that right, feel free to quit. MR. TRAXI...I know I was wrong. I'll drive right now. Before his father closes the door, Ricky stops him. RICKYShannon, that's enough. SHANNONOh look, the "young master" is mad. KARENShannon, you may not like me, but there's no need to bully Ricky. He's always nice to you. He had the driver come back just for you. Why do you have to be so mean? RICKYNo need to tell her that. She doesn't know anything about gratitude.
Shannon, you've really crossed the line this time. Shannon rolls her eyes.
EXT. SKYSCRAPER - NIGHT14 14
Establishing shot of where Shannon lives.
INT. SHANNON'S PENTHOUSE - KITCHEN - NIGHT15 15

Shannon walks into the huge, open concept kitchen filled with natural light and spectacular views of the city. She finds an older woman, AUNT JO, preparing dinner. Jo takes her handbag. AUNT JOMiss, you're back alone? Where’s your friend Ricky? SHANNONAunt Jo, from now on, I don't have any friends named Ricky. AUNT JOMiss, you’ve finally come to your senses. With instant regret crossing the boundary, Aunt Jo covers her mouth awkwardly. Shannon reaches out and holds her hand. SHANNON (V.O.)Aunt jo was the kindest of all the servants in the house. In my past life, she always warned me about Ricky, but I was so blind in love that I pushed her away. In this life, I won’t fail her again.

AUNT JOSorry miss, I spoke out of turn... SHANNONIt’s okay, Aunt jo. You were right. I'm going to go lay down for a bit. It's been a long day. AUNT JOAlright. Oh, Johnny Wonder came to visit. I can send him away though, if you're tired... About to leave the room, hearing that, Shannon's face lights up in excitement. SHANNONJohnny? Where is he? Aunt Jo points and Shannon runs that direction.
EXT. SHANNON'S PENTHOUSE - TERRACE - NIGHT16 16

Shannon steps out of the house and sees, standing in a pool of light, the most handsome young man in the world, JOHNNY WONDER. This is the first time she's seen him since being reborn. He hears her gasp and turns. The entire world slows down as this beautiful person turns to rest his eyes on Shannon. SHANNON (V.O.)This is 20 year old Johnny, the fiancé my father arranged for me. In my past life, because of Ricky Trax, I was not fond of him. He wanted to be with me, but I wanted only Ricky. I not only refused him but also said hurtful things to him. She holds back tears. Johnny isn't sure what's up but he only cares for her. SHANNONJohnny, it's so nice to see you again. JOHNNYMiss Clark, it’s nice to see you too. SHANNONJohnny, is there something you needed?

JOHNNYI wanted to see you. Hesitating, in awkward silence. JOHNNY(cont'd)I know you don’t want to see me, so I’ll go. Johnny turns away, ready to leave, when Shannon stops him. SHANNONJohnny... She almost grabs his hand to stop him from going. SHANNON(cont'd)Would you like to have dinner with me? JOHNNYReally? The romantic tension between them is insane. We half-expect them to start making out right then and there. SHANNONSure. Aunt Jo is the best chef! As she leads Johnny inside she can't help looking over her shoulder and smiling at him.
INT. SHANNON'S PENTHOUSE - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT23

At a elegant glass desk, Johnny and Shannon sit next to each other. Johnny diligently works through a complicated math problem, explaining the steps, but Shannon stares at him dreamily, absorbed in her own thoughts. SHANNON (V.O.)God, Johnny is nothing like Ricky. Johnny has patience, he speaks well, he never complains. And OH MY GOODNESS is he handsome. (beat) How could I have been so blind in my previous life?

How could I waste all my time on someone like Ricky Trax. Especially when Johnny was right there all along! She doesn't realize Johnny is watching her think. JOHNNYIs there something you don’t understand? She doesn't say anything, just keeps looking at him. Then she realizes he said something and snaps out of it. SHANNONSorry, I’m just too dumb. JOHNNYShannon, you're not dumb. You're just using the wrong study method. Let me help you build a stronger foundation first, then if your grades don't improve...you can fire me and I'll return everything you've paid me already. SHANNONAre you sure? You really mean that? Johnny nods. Then they smile at each other. Ricky stomps into the room. He doesn't even acknowledge Johnny and rips into Shannon. RICKYShannon, seriously, what’s your deal? She speaks slowly and clearly, like she's dealing with a child. SHANNONWhat do you want now? RICKYYou threw my things in the basement! Johnny carefully watches the back and forth. SHANNONI told you this afternoon, you've been fired. I have a new tutor. So why should you stay at my house? Especially in such a nice room? ESPECIALLY after I fired your father too! But if you insist on staying, the basement is all yours. Ricky slams his palms on the desk. Shannon doesn't flinch.

RICKYShannon, do you think it's fun to humiliate me? SHANNONHumiliate you? Stop being so dramatic. RICKYFine, Shannon, don’t think I don’t know what you’re up to. RICKY (V.O.)Tomorrow at the birthday party, I’ll make sure you regret this. I’ll make you kneel in front of everyone and apologize. Shannon slaps the papers with each word, trying to break through Ricky's dense idiocy. SHANNONWe’re still in class. Can you stop interrupting us? Ricky is thrown off his game. He's still not used to Shannon resisting him. RICKYFine. Just wait. Ricky points a finger at Shannon. Johnny shifts his weight, ready to leap in and defend Shannon if necessary. Ricky and Shannon both notice.
INT. SHANNON'S PENTHOUSE - KITCHEN - NIGHT17 17

Aunt Jo bustles in the kitchen while Shannon and Johnny sit shyly near each other trying to steal looks at the other but not get caught doing it. SHANNONAunt jo, let’s start dinner. AUNT JOWe're not waiting for Ricky? Hearing "Ricky", Johnny's eyes dart to Shannon, watching to see what she'll say. SHANNONWhy? AUNT JO (V.O.)Thank goodness, Miss Shannon won't be such a suck-up anymore.

AUNT JOI’ll get everything ready right away. SHANNONJohnny, you're grades are really good, aren't they? Mine are terrible. Would you mind...being my tutor? You could come here every day and help me study. JOHNNYI thought Ricky Trax was your tutor? JOHNNY (V.O.)And you love him so much you pushed me far away from you. SHANNONHe’s about to be fired. Johnny barely suppresses a smile. JOHNNYIf you would like, I'm available. Maybe we could begin tomorrow? SHANNONYes. Tomorrow, then. Johnny leaves. Moments later Ricky storms in, angry. RICKYShannon, why'd you tear my dad a new one in front of everyone? What's wrong with you? Go apologize to him right now or I'll-- SHANNONI disciplined my driver. I pay his salary and he leaves me on the side of the road! And you think I should apologize? RICKYHe's my dad! Anything he did was because I told him to do it!That’s my dad! It had nothing to do with him. If you have an issue, deal with me! SHANNONOh, right. Your father answers to you. In that case, you can both pack your bags and go. RICKYWhat? What did you just say?
He feels a thrill of fear. He knows he's playing with fire and in danger of getting burned. Shannon is ready to set him on fire.
INT. SHANNON'S PENTHOUSE - FRONT DOOR - NIGHT24

As Ricky passes through the kitchen, he pauses and holds up three fingers. RICKYShe'll be here in three, two, one... He turns around, grinning smugly. She's not there. RICKY(cont'd)What the heck? Why is Shannon suddenly acting so tough? She knows she's making me angry. I swear she is going to learn a hard lesson.
INT. SHANNON'S PENTHOUSE - KITCHEN - NIGHT18 18

Shannon slams her hand on the table. Rattling dishes. Her hand landing near the handle of a very sharp knife. SHANNONI don't want you here anymore! Ever since you started tutoring me, my grades have only gotten worse. Why am I paying you anything at all! RICKYIt's not my fault your stupid! I explain the same thing to Karen, one time, the same way and she gets it. Why can't you? Because you're as dumb as a rock. Switch tutors, see if I care, but don't come crawling back when you fail even faster. SHANNONFine! I will, but you and your good for nothing Dad can't live here anymore. I want you both out! Ricky tries a different approach, full-condescension. RICKYOK, OK, it's you're not dumb, Shannon. You're obsessed with dating me so you can't focus. That's why your grades are so bad. SHANNONWhat are you talking about? RICKYYou’re causing all this fuss because you’re jealous of my relationship with Karen, right? SHANNONYou think I want to be with you? RICKYOh my god, it's OBVIOUS! SHANNONRicky Trax, being with you is the last thing I want in this life!
RICKYSay whatever you want. But I am warning you—if you disrespect me like that in public again...whatever I do next is your fault.
INT. CAR - DAY19 19

After school, Shannon gets in the car and shuts the door. After a moment of confusion she looks at the driver. SHANNONLet’s go. Ricky walks over with Karen next to him. RICKYDad’s let's drop off Karen first. MR. TRAXAlright, my boy. SHANNONDriver, did you even ask for my opinion? From now on, there will be no unnecessary people in my car. Including him. Ricky shoves his way into the car, but Shannon refuses to make enough room for Karen, who stands there watching. MR. TRAXMiss Shannon, you have a good relationship with Ricky, right? Don't let something small hurt your feelings for him. SHANNONMister Trax, I don’t think suited to driving. Someone who loves doling out advice should be a therapist. Was that your dream? Could you not cut it in med school? Is that why you're a driver? RICKYShannon! That's enough! How can y ou talk to my fa--your driver like that? SHANNONHow dare YOU speak to YOUR employer this way? She literally kicks him out of the car.

SHANNON(cont'd)You think you’re worthy to sit with me? (to Mr. Trax) DRIVE! He drives. Leaving his own son on the side of the road. RICKYShannon, you've really pissed me off this time! I'll see you on your knees begging for my forgiveness! KARENRicky, what’s going on with you? She's the daughter of your driver. Why are you letting her push you around like this? KAREN (V.O.)Everyone says she's the rich one and you're the fake...maybe they're right?
INT. CLASSROOM - DAY20 20

The next morning at school. Shannon is at her desk reading when Ricky comes up and leans over her. RICKYShannon, I heard you were talking to Johnny Wonder. SHANNONWhat's it to you? RICKYBringing him around, trying to make me jealous isn't going to make me forgive you, if that's what you think. SHANNONWhy would I think that? I don't even like thinking about you. RICKYYou know, I can’t stand women who can’t make up their minds. Am I making myself clear? She glares up at him, narrowing her eyes. SHANNONOh, I've made up my mind about you.
INT. CLASSROOM - DAY21 21

Shannon stands up, forcing Ricky to take a step back so she doesn't bash him with her head. SHANNONI can't believe I tolerated you for so long. You treat me this way and then spend MY money on...KAREN? Ricky punches the table, trying to restrain his anger. RICKYYour money? I earned that money trying to fix your dumb brain! Compensation for heavy labor! SHANNONMaybe if I demand a refund my grades will go back up! RICKYI already told you it's not my fault! It's your mind that's the problem! SHANNONRicky, you’re fired! RICKYYou think someone else-- SHANNONI already hired a new tutor. Ricky moves closer, keeping his voice lower, not sure if Shannon is playing the part he wants her to play. RICKYShannon, if you're playing hard to get or something you need to cut it out. If you keep this up, I really won’t be your tutor anymore and where do you think that leaves you? SHANNONOh my god, and you call me dumb. Ricky, you are fiieee-rrrrrr-DUH! Shannon walks out of the room. RICKYYou-- Ricky is about to follow Shannon but Karen blocks his path. KARENRicky, what's really going on with you and Shannon?

RICKYWho knows? Don’t gives a shit. KARENRight. OK. Anyway, tomorrow is your birthday. Are we still celbrating at your family's hotel? Are you going to help me rent a dress? Ricky? Ricky! RICKYWhat? No. Why would you rent a dress? I'll buy you one. Karen smiles slyly to herself. Free dress coming her way. Ricky looks away, distracted by something he just realized. RICKY (V.O.)THAT'S what's going on. Shannon always plans my birthday celebrations. She's just acting dramatic to heighten the surprise. Ha, nice try Shannon but I told you you were going to far. You'll find my forgiveness costs more than a birthday party. Ricky smiles to himself.
INT. CLASSROOM - DAY22 22

Ricky looks at Karen, smiling to himself. She doesn't understand why he's looking so smug. KARENRicky, why aren’t you saying anything? Instead of answering, Ricky wraps his arm around Karen's waist and turns so they both face the rest of the class. Everyone listens intently. RICKYListen up everyone, tomorrow night at the Royal Court Hotel, it’s my 20th birthday. There will be food, music, drink...a night to remember! The class can't contain their excitement. SUEOh my god! The Royal Court Hotel? That's like...higher than five stars! I can't believe he's celebrating there!

YANCEYOf course he is, the Trax family OWNS the Royal Court. The staff literally BOW to Ricky. Ricky and Karen watch Sue and Yancey praise them with a mixture of smugness and embarrassment. SUEHoly shit! Yancey, you HAVE to get me a ticket! RICKYWhat are you talking about, Sue? A ticket? I personally invited you! Every single one of you is personally invited! While the crowd cheers...Karen speaks to Ricky. KARENRicky, do you think Shannon will come? Should we invite her? RICKYHer? Even if I don’t send her an invitation, she’ll come running. RICKY (V.O.)Shannon, you think you're so clever. You think this party will save you? Nope, you're in a for rude awakening. NOBODY disrespects me. KARENYeah, she can't stay away from you. I'll have to teach her a lesson. Karen looks up lovingly at Ricky, with the faintest of smirks on her face.
